source.license_review_notes: Paraphrased claims and citation links only; no copied upstream text, code, or weights are stored in either intake. License posture for any NoisyNet / RND / Plan2Explore reference implementation must be re-verified before a code-reference content_mode is used.

evidence_summary.notes: Two-source convergence intake (NoisyNet primary undirected-floor + RND/Plan2Explore secondary directed-curiosity) on the tonic, state-conditioned, self-annealing exploration mechanism the MECH-313/MECH-314 cluster needs. Primary sources are peer-reviewed/archival (ICLR/NeurIPS-tier + Nature/Cell biology anchors). Intake is partial pending equation-level extraction of the NoisyNet sigma trajectory and a REE-side E2-disagreement readout. A biology lit-pull (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005, Tervo et al. 2014, Daw et al. 2006) precedes registration per the SD-003 / SD-010-011 discipline and SUPPORTS the state-conditioned + self-annealing refinement. Candidate claims register as candidate/substrate_ceiling and promote nothing on their own.

falsification.claim_under_test: The tonic exploration noise floor that GAP-C/GAP-H name (MECH-313 LC-NE analog) should be a STATE-CONDITIONED, SELF-ANNEALING signal that PROPAGATES into the committed action -- achieved via learned per-parameter weight noise at the selection head (MECH-440, NoisyNet analog) and/or a per-candidate self-annealing model-disagreement curiosity signal (MECH-441, RND/Plan2Explore analog) -- rather than the current state-independent post-softmax temperature floor (which V3-EXQ-687 found non-propagating) or the broadcast-novelty EMA channel (V3-EXQ-590a non-propagating).
could_be_wrong_if: Selection-head parametric weight noise does NOT raise committed (argmax) selected_action_entropy above a matched-pre-commit-variance post-softmax temperature control on >=2/3 seeds (washes out at argmax identically, reproducing the r1a_entropy_only_artefact) -- falsifies MECH-440.
Selection-head weight noise raises pre-commit entropy but NOT committed-action diversity (thrash, not carve) -- falsifies MECH-440.

A per-candidate self-annealing model-disagreement bonus is cross-candidate flat (degenerate) or does not propagate into committed-action selection (reproduces the V3-EXQ-590a broadcast-EMA failure) -- falsifies MECH-441.

The committed-action-diversity ceiling turns out to be driven entirely by the F-dominance selection-variance monopoly (MECH-439), in which case a propagating noise floor still loses to F-share and the fix is variance rebalancing, not the injection locus.
falsification.notes: Falsifiers are pre-registered per candidate claim; the V3-EXQ-687 four-arm tonic-noise instrumentation (selected_action_entropy, unique_actions) supplies the metric a future MECH-440 falsifier would reuse, contrasted against a matched-pre-commit-variance temperature control.

governance_controls.conflict_review_notes: Convergence-side conflict scan complete: the candidate claims register as candidate/substrate_ceiling/v3, wired into depends_on of the GAP-C cluster (MECH-313/MECH-260/Q-045/ARC-065) and the GAP-H curiosity leg (MECH-314/ARC-065), and block no V3 closure node. They do not move any existing claim status or conflict ratio. The biology lit-pull flags that MECH-313's state-independent framing is biologically under-specified (a refinement target, not a contradiction). REE_assembly governance adjudication still required before any decide-to-build.
rollback_conditions: Any net increase in unresolved claim conflicts in the GAP-C / GAP-H exploration cluster after registration.
Either candidate claim being mistakenly placed on the V3 critical path (owner_exq / blocker of a V3 closure node).

benchmark_acceptance_criteria.target: strictly above matched-pre-commit-variance temperature control on >=2/3 seeds, non-degenerate
benchmark_acceptance_criteria.notes: The MECH-440 propagation falsifier: selection-head weight noise must reach the committed action where the temperature floor did not.
The candidates must keep the V3 closure percentage clean (no V3 plan node blocked on them).

implementation_readiness.notes: Decide-whether-to-build is a later governance step. If built, MECH-440 would add a learned parametric-weight-noise lever to the E3 selection head (no-op default); MECH-441 would add an E2 forward-model disagreement readout feeding the MECH-314 curiosity bonus (no-op default). Both gated by the V3-primacy version-layering doctrine (bit-identical OFF).

deltas.title: State-conditioned, self-annealing, propagating noise floor at the selection head (MECH-440, NoisyNet analog)
deltas.proposal: Register a candidate REE claim that the MECH-313 tonic exploration floor should be injected as learned per-parameter (factorised-Gaussian) weight noise in the E3 selection pathway, so it propagates into the committed action, is state-conditioned by construction, and self-anneals via a gradient-trained per-parameter sigma -- rather than the current state-independent post-softmax temperature floor that V3-EXQ-687 found non-propagating.
deltas.rationale: NoisyNet is the working external instance of a tonic floor that survives the argmax/commit step; REE's MECH-313 floor is discarded at argmax (V3-EXQ-687 r1a_entropy_only_artefact). Biology (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005; Tervo et al. 2014) grounds the state-conditioned + self-annealing refinement.

deltas.title: Per-candidate self-annealing model-disagreement curiosity (MECH-441, RND/Plan2Explore analog)
deltas.proposal: Register a candidate REE claim that MECH-314 structured curiosity should be a per-candidate, self-annealing signal derived from E2 forward-model disagreement, fed into E3 selection so it propagates per-candidate to the committed action -- addressing the V3-EXQ-590a/141b broadcast-novelty-EMA non-propagation; self-annealing-on-learning-progress is the non-degeneracy guard.
deltas.rationale: Plan2Explore's ensemble model-disagreement and RND's predictor-error novelty are the working external instances of self-annealing directed curiosity; biology (Daw et al. 2006) grounds a dedicated frontopolar directed-exploration substrate. Complementary to the MECH-440 undirected floor (ARC-065 substrates (a)+(b)).

decisions.notes: Recommended outcome hybridize: the two mechanisms are complementary (MECH-440 undirected tonic floor + MECH-441 directed curiosity = ARC-065 substrates (a)+(b)). Final outcome and any decide-to-build set during REE_assembly governance adjudication; the candidate claims are already registered (candidate/substrate_ceiling/v3, user-approved per-child 2026-06-18).
